KSU_2007_p95__paragraph_1.ocr:
The Company owns 16.6% of the Kansas City Terminal Railway Company, which owns and operates
80 miles of track and operates an additional eight miles of track under trackage rights in greater Kansas City,
Missouri. This investment is accounted for under the cost method of accounting and had a balance of
$3.8 million as of December 31, 2007 and $3.5 million as of December 31, 2006.
